chapter: Pay, the Fletcher Henderson circle and later life
title: Substituting for Coleman Hawkins in Fletcher Henderson's band
summary: When Hawkins went off driving in his car, Caldwell pinch hit for him and found the salary fantastic.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Yeah, because I played in Hawk's

place. Whenever they'd come back in town, Hawk would take off, sent for Hawk would call me. and Fletcher would Hap, I -- be off. I said, where [Note] you going? He said, I'm going on up -- 'cause he had his car. But I'd have to go down there and pinch hit for him, many times.
You know, he had his car.
Because they must have been making -- because when I worked in his place for about a week, and the salary was fantastic.
Yeah, well, he must -- I suppose there were a few years -- that was about, (unintelligible) well it was the biggest band of all.
